external_entities.name: supplier
external_entities.description: Suppliers upload compliance paperwork and sign in to the portal with vendor-issued credentials.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal

external_entities.name: category manager
external_entities.description: Category managers review uploaded paperwork and approve or reject it from the corporate network.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.

external_entities.name: vendor
external_entities.description: The vendor hosts the SaaS portal and pushes a nightly supplier data extract to the landing bucket.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

processes.name: portal
processes.description: A vendor-hosted SaaS supplier document portal used for uploading, reviewing, and approving compliance paperwork.
processes.notes: The vendor's datasheet says the platform is secure by design, uses enterprise-grade encryption throughout, and that all access is fully authenticated and audited.

processes.name: supplier master service
processes.description: A service in the cloud account that loads the nightly extract and writes records into the supplier database.
processes.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_stores.name: vendor platform
data_stores.description: The vendor platform where the uploaded compliance documents remain.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.

data_stores.name: landing bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket in the organization's cloud account receiving the nightly supplier data extract.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_stores.notes: The runbook says the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is.

data_stores.name: supplier database
data_stores.description: The database in the organization's cloud account into which supplier records are written.
data_stores.source_excerpt: writes the records into the supplier database

data_flows.name: upload paperwork
data_flows.description: Supplier uploads compliance paperwork through the portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal
data_flows.data_description: Insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for supplier staff.

data_flows.name: review and approve
data_flows.description: Category manager reviews uploaded paperwork and approves or rejects it through the portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it
data_flows.data_description: Uploaded compliance paperwork and approval or rejection decision.

data_flows.name: push extract
data_flows.description: Vendor pushes the nightly supplier data extract to the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket
data_flows.notes: The source says, 'We were told the nightly extract is encrypted end to end.' The landing bucket runbook says, 'the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is.' These claims do not establish a single encryption value for the flow.

data_flows.name: load extract
data_flows.description: Supplier master service loads the extract from the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file
data_flows.data_description: Nightly supplier data extract in CSV format.

data_flows.name: write records
data_flows.description: Supplier master service writes supplier records into the supplier database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the records into the supplier database
data_flows.data_description: Supplier records from the nightly extract.

trust_boundaries.name: supplier environment
trust_boundaries.description: The environment controlled by suppliers, who access the portal and provide paperwork.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal

trust_boundaries.name: vendor hosting
trust_boundaries.description: The vendor-controlled hosting environment for the SaaS portal and vendor platform.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The organization's corporate network from which category managers work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network

trust_boundaries.name: cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The organization's cloud account containing the landing bucket, supplier master service, and supplier database.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The bucket, the service and the database are all in our cloud account.

assumptions.assumption: The compliance paperwork and supplier records are confidential because they include staff contact details and business compliance information.
assumptions.basis: The vendor platform stores insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for supplier staff.

assumptions.assumption: The landing bucket data is confidential because it contains supplier data extracts.
assumptions.basis: The landing bucket receives a supplier data extract.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier database data is confidential because it contains supplier records derived from the supplier data extract.
assumptions.basis: The supplier master service writes supplier records into the supplier database.
